charts.title: disintegration-spatial-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the disintegration run: a single CPM cell centered on a shared 60x60 field grid inside a radial stressor gradient, diffusing inward from the periphery. The cell holds coherent through tick 6, then visibly shrinks as it resorbs once released_tick == 7, its vacated pixels appearing as a scattering debris cloud that keeps spreading outward even after the domain has fully dissolved. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_disintegration_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: disintegration-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly time-series panel of the same run, synced to the GIF's time axis: area, mean footprint stressor, particle count, and connected-component count over the full run. Area falls from ~62 to 0 as released_tick == 7 is crossed, mean stressor rises past viability_threshold at the same tick, and particle count climbs to 68 and holds flat once resorption completes -- the full hold-cross-resorb-scatter arc made directly visible. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick values.
